notes: Korea Zinc is a non-ferrous metal smelter/refiner, not a mine operator. Incorporated 1974; headquartered in Seoul. Core business: smelting imported concentrates into refined zinc (zinc slab ingots, alloy jumbo blocks, anode ingots, die-cast ingots), plus lead and lead-alloy ingots, copper cathodes, gold, silver, rare metals (indium, bismuth, antimony, cadmium, tellurium, cobalt, selenium), and sulfuric acid. Holds ~10% of world refined zinc output; zinc accounts for over 60% of revenue. Owns no mines: it buys concentrates from miners and earns smelting/refining charges plus by-product metal value. Also engages in battery materials, recycling, logistics, and e-waste processing. Included in this miners dataset only as a smelter/refiner record with no mine-level data.
